svg.text: The baseline applied before the first workload: one identity nobody uses, short-lived access for people, and account-wide logging, detection and safe defaults.

svg.text: A cost spike is often the first sign of stolen access keys, which is why the budget alarm is part of the security baseline.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Root: 2 keys, 0 access keys. People: 3 groups, sessions of 1 to 4 hours. Controls supported: AC-2, AC-6(5), IA-2(1), AU-2, AU-12, SI-4, SC-28; CIS AWS Foundations 1 to 4.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not AWS artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
